messages:
lina-devrel: Hey everyone — publishing community-local-dev-images v1.0.0 today. Purpose: one-click local dev stack (console + redwoodctl dev + lightweight mock runtime) to make onboarding and hackweeks easier. Release notes and tags:
https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-dev-images/releases/tag/v1.0.0
Docker Hub: https://hub.docker.com/r/redwood/community-local-dev-images/tags

Quick start:
```
docker pull redwood/community-local-dev:1.0.0
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -e RW_ENV=dev redwood/community-local-dev:1.0.0
```

Highlights:
- docker-compose setup with console + mock runtime
- multi-arch support (amd64 + arm64)
- trimmed deps and smaller base image
- builtin sample prompts + small local eval harness
- automated Snyk scan (summary below)

We're running an optional 30-min 'bring-your-laptop' office hours (tomorrow 16:00 UTC) in #eng-devex for maintainers. Tag me if you want an invite. :tada:

sam-engineer: Nice! Any breaking changes to existing dev flow? Will this replace the repo's docker-compose.yml?

lina-devrel: Short answer: no breaking changes. Image is opt-in. We added docker-compose.override.example that wires the image in. To test locally:
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-dev-images.git
cd community-dev-images
docker pull redwood/community-local-dev:1.0.0
./scripts/start-local.sh
```

claire-eng: Image size?

lina-devrel: ~420MB compressed on Docker Hub; layered result is ~150MB on-device with BuildKit/cache. We removed heavy dev deps and switched to a slim distroless layer.

snyk-bot: Snyk scan result for v1.0.0 — 0 critical, 2 medium (dev deps). Full report: https://snyk.io/org/redwood/projects/abc123

maya-docs: I'll update CONTRIBUTING.md and add a troubleshooting FAQ.

roj-platform: Can we plug this into the quickstart templates for workshops?

lina-devrel: Yes — will open a PR to quickstarts tomorrow and add a short demo notebook.

sam-engineer: I'll test on M1 later today, will ping @lina-devrel if I hit issues. :rocket:
